bridges.falsifier: A destination experiment with vanishing target loss but nonvanishing posterior-score distortion, or with useful score small-ball geometry only on a vanishing-probability set. N61 is a stress test against inferring EB reconstruction from marginal broadcasting alone.

bridges.alignment: N71/N72/N73 concern Gaussian optical count laws under passive loss; N42 concerns conditional counts from a positive rational Bargmann kernel. The possible overlap is a passive squeezed-vacuum subclass where the exact kernel and herald weights can both be acquired.
assumptions: Known passive contraction and bounded independent squeezed-vacuum inputs with vacuum environments, as in N71.
The same physical output admits N42's entrywise-nonnegative rational Bargmann representation and specified herald marginalization.
Conditional numerator and denominator have exact-zero detection and relative, rather than additive-only, approximation.
bridges.acquisition: Acquire exact rational conversion from passive covariance/input data to the nonnegative Bargmann kernel, the herald event weights, and any counting service. N71's covariance oracle does not supply this conversion.
bridges.cost: Charge E0/expected reset count, active rank and scalar survival/inversion arithmetic (N71); charge numeric E,h, bit length and worst-case relative-counting cost (N42); charge rational precision schedule (N73). bridges.falsifier: An allowed event with probability below the unconditional TV error, or an allowed passive covariance whose Bargmann coefficients have signs/phases or bit growth outside N42's premise. Either prevents a relative conditional guarantee.

bridges.alignment: N42/N96 can supply positive probabilities or coherent preparation for specified count events/pins. N46 concerns a single EB channel on a full algebra. A narrow overlap exists only when the legal experiment and losses factor through an acquired diagonal count algebra.
assumptions: The input family is block-diagonal in the acquired count basis and every admissible loss/measurement factors through that basis.
The positive kernel/prefix representation covers the entire induced label law uniformly over inputs, not only one herald or pin.
The claim is restricted to this measurement algebra; arbitrary POVMs, purification, and independent-copy preservation are excluded.
bridges.acquisition: Acquire count basis, positive rational representation, legal measurement family, support/prefix services, and any phases needed for coherent compilation. N46's full-algebra trace-covering net is a separate acquisition.
bridges.cost: Charge photon energy/cutoff, event parameters and relative counting (N42), support/prefix counts, phases and reversible circuit cost (N96), and uniform label-law error. For full N46, additionally charge full-algebra net/channel construction.
